definition.radiance: CoutLinear=T*ClitLinear+(1-T)*CairLinear for homogeneous constant airlight; layered airlight requires front-to-back radiance integration
definition.legacy2Percent: Old weather-moments visibilityEquivalentM uses approximately 3.912/sigma (2% contrast). Recompute from actual sigma with 2.995732/sigma for this pack; never relabel unchanged numbers.

states.clear: Dry clean atmosphere fallback; cloud cover alone does not imply haze.
states.hazy: Aerosol haze episode, no invented smoke plume.
states.humid: Humid haze fallback, not RH-to-visibility law; humidity alone cannot prove poor visibility.
states.smoke: Verified/adapted smoke or aerosol event; no direct AQI-to-sigma conversion. Defaults shared across regions intentionally because event severity dominates location.
states.rain: Steady falling rain; surface wetness alone does not trigger it. Defaults shared across regions.
states.snow: Falling snow; settled snow alone does not reduce visibility. Defaults shared across regions.

priority: valid uncensored representative visibility observation/model with units and convention
region + local season + current verified weather state authored fallback
selection.censoredObservation: 10SM means visibility >=16.09344km; 9999 means >=10km. Keep lower-bound flag. Do not force Denver to 16km or extrapolate a precise 100km measurement. Combine with regional prior as an explicitly estimated fallback; if severe current event contradicts it, use representative current event input.
selection.combinedStates: One observed total visibility already includes aerosols/precipitation: replace total sigma, never add same contributors again. Without a total observation use the minimum candidate fallback visibility (maximum sigma), an authored conservative approximation, not additive physics. Add only independently calibrated component extinction.
selection.smokeAQI: No universal PM2.5/AQI conversion: particle size, humidity and composition vary.

staleData.status: authored freshness policy, source cadence may override
staleData.rule: Expired observations lose live status; use fresh model/event if available else marked estimated region/state fallback. Never silently clear a known smoke/fog/squall alert; expired event uses conservative event fallback marked uncertain until resolved.

selection.transitionSpace: interpolate extinction (optical depth), not visibility distance; severe validated low visibility snaps within 1s
selection.invalidVisibility: Reject null/nonfinite/<=0; do not clamp bad inputs into clear weather. Valid values outside preset ranges remain valid.

airlight.mix: Decode day and time hex; mix in linear light using timeMix. Prefer physically lit directional sky/horizon radiance when supported. These are authored palette fallbacks, not spectral scattering data.
airlight.distanceTint: Distance changes T only; no additional distance desaturation or second fog grade. At tau .1 mix9.52%, tau .5 mix39.35%, tau1 mix63.21%, tau3 mix95.02%. Silhouettes approach actual directional airlight, not saturated blue or white. Night lighting changes airlight, not sigma just because it is dark.
airlight.preserveCalibration: Exposure, matte materials, saturation and warm direct sunlight remain calibration-v2. No local lamps added to global airlight.

mountains.retainRule: Require real map/DEM position and unoccluded curved-earth sightline; cloud/stratus may cut off summits. Compute linear luminance horizon contrast C0=abs(Ymountain-Yair)/max(Yair,0.001); retainedContrast=C0*T. Keep silhouette when retainedContrast>=0.05 and projected height>=2px. Simplify internal detail below 0.10 contrast; fade/cull geometry below0.03, with smooth transition across0.03–0.05. Thresholds are phone authoring targets, not guaranteed human visual acuity.
mountains.important: MOR is not a hard clip plane. A mountain may be obscured closer than MOR because initial contrast is lower than a black test target. Peaks above a boundary haze layer can remain visible; integrate actual ray through layers rather than applying ground visibility uniformly to every altitude.
mountains.nominalMaxDistance: dMax=ln(C0/0.05)/sigma; for C0=.5 dMax=.7686*V (same distance units)
mountains.geography: Sloan lake west view has Front Range; east downtown view has no mountains behind downtown. Never invent mountain positions.
mountains.curvature: Use geocentric terrain/rays for20–100km; no flat-earth horizon. Refraction off unless validated model.
mountains.lod: 20km relief/major folds;50km silhouette + large lit planes;100km simplified horizon. Actual projected size and contrast decide, not arbitrary mountain boost.

integration.sharedWorldTerm: Same view-ray optical depth for land, water, buildings, trees and terrain. Atmosphere-rendered sky/reflections must not receive duplicate atmospheric passes.
integration.localFog: Preserve night-fog/marine-fog layer bounds, patch masks and densitites. Base sigma from this pack; add local sigma only for physically traversed local layer. If observation already represents that local layer, fit layer plus background to total rather than adding observation and layer twice.
integration.layerColour: Single final homogeneous mix only if airlight is common; otherwise integrate each segment front to back with its airlight. Optical-depth-weighted colour alone is not exact for layered media.
integration.regionalSeasonRanges: All ranges describe scenario authoring envelopes, not percentiles, observations or prevalence. Uniform event defaults are deliberate conditional fallbacks. Use local data for mountain-valley inversions, SF marine fog, wildfire layers, tropical wet/dry seasons and location variation.

overrides.scope: Replace background haze only; preserve water colours (#315F7F Lake Michigan), waves, ice, shore and snow mechanics.

Replace homogeneous/background sigma and convert visibility convention; preserve localLayerExtinctionPerM unless independently recalibrated. Moment palette/time stays; use this pack airlight as general fallback.

sources.supports: WMO Guide No.8 (2008), Part I ch9: MOR uses 5% transmission; homogeneous extinction conversion. Mathematical definition, not regional climatology.
ASOS METAR 10SM is a censored upper reporting bin, not an exact clear-day visibility.
